class_weight_formula: weight_c = N / (K * count_c); K = NUM_CLASSES = 3; N and count_c derived from the TRAINING split only, per facet; sample_weight[i] = weight_{y_i}
selection_criterion: fixed baseline: n_estimators=300, no early stopping, no hyperparameter search; primary reported metric = mean macro-F1 across the five facets (validation, then final test evaluation)
